description: You play the role of agent 008 in this fast-paced, entertaining and quick snooker game. As an agent, your mission is to sink all the balls before the time expires. But beware! One of the balls is a time bomb planted by the terrorist organization CHALK that can be activated. If it explodes, you lose precious time, while if you sink it before it explodes you get additional time to complete the mission. How fast can you complete the mission? This snooker game is not about realism, but about having fun. Note: This game is a port of the original agent008ball.com. It has been optimized to work with
